text:
maria: Heads-up — we need a preflight review call for CCG (Acme) on‑prem rollout. Proposed: Wed 2026-04-02 09:00 PDT / 16:00 UTC. Can folks confirm? High‑level agenda: network, certs, capacity/canaries, rollback, monitoring.

raj: Prefer 10:00 PDT for me, or Tue same window if that helps.

sam: I can do 09:30–11:00 PDT. Looks good — suggest adding 'data egress/compliance' and 'DB migration plan' to agenda.

julie-cs: I'll invite the customer PM (@acme_pm) and their engineer. Adding maintenance window ask to invite. Preflight doc: https://redwood.example.com/onprem/acme-preflight 

kevin-sre-bot: Preflight checklist:
```
- Network: VPN + routing + peering verified
- Certs: CA chain + SANs for *.acme.local and ops.acme.local
- Capacity: validated node count, GPU health, stress test pass
- Rollback: snapshot/restore + DNS reroute plan
- Monitoring: dashboards + alert thresholds set
- Security: KMS keys provisioned, audit logging enabled
```

alina: I can own the network verification. Will run smoke tests (ping, metallb, route tables) and post results by EOD Tue.

maria: Thanks — locking in Wed 2026-04-02 09:00 PDT. Invite sent to SRE, Eng, CS, and customer. Action items: @sam own DB migration steps; @alina run network smoke tests; @kevin-sre-bot ensure canary policy + autoscale config ready. Add any blockers here. :thumbsup:

sam: Got it — I'll post the migration steps + rollback steps by Tue morning.

julie-cs: I'll confirm customer PM availability and ask them to share the IPs they'll originate connections from.

maria: If anyone can't make the time, reply here and suggest alternatives. Otherwise we'll treat this as the final time and prep items due Tue EOD.

raj: 10:00 PDT works if Wed becomes necessary — otherwise I'm good with 09:00.

alina: Confirmed — will upload smoke test logs and the curl/wget checks to the doc link before EOD Tue.

kevin-sre-bot: Canary policy template: https://redwood.example.com/playbooks/canary-template — tagging infra-runbooks.

maria: Awesome, thanks team. See you on the call.
